what: A section clock in the style of a basketball shot clock. A two-digit 5×7 dot LED counts down from 24 to 0 seconds over a set range (from the head of the second section to just before the last section), and the 24 ticks below go out one by one. When the section changes, its name is printed with a .6s scramble, and under 5 seconds one decimal place and the ticks switch to the accent color. On entering the range, the panel unfolds in a single frame from .06 height while the LED flickers on (.5s). Past the end, it flashes three times like a buzzer (.78s) and then folds flat. Pressing the panel makes the section list rise from the bottom row at 45ms intervals (.55s expo.out), and hovering a row previews that section’s remaining seconds in .38s. Pressing a row glides to that section in 1.8s.

options.[data-fx-part=chapter]: Every section Name One — a part reads it and turns it into an LED panel and a list (restores when removed)
options.from: Element that starts the seconds count (selector), default second section
options.to: Element (selector) where the seconds hit 0 — when its top reaches 1.1 screens above the bottom of the screen. Default is the document end
options.look: inline: Placed in position instead of attaching to the screen (demo · sidebar)
options.--fx-sc-fg · --fx-sc-glass: Text color and glass panel color (via style) — the side that passes over a light panel changes them (ink color in the original closing section)

use: Tip-offOn the court…
note: If window.lenis exists, it reads that scroll value and moves with it. To hide on phones, use @media (max-width: 991px) in the consuming css { display: none } — the original also loads only at 992 and up
